name: Laptop Price Monitor - Paginated Scrape, Diff & Alert

parameters.content:
## Laptop Price Monitor
Baseline template: **Competitor price monitoring with web scraping, Google Sheets & Telegram** (n8n.io/workflows/4640).

Daily 09:00 (Europe/Istanbul) scrape of every `?page=N` of the webscraper.io laptop catalogue, USD price strings sanitised to floats, snapshot appended to Google Sheets with an ISO timestamp, diff against the latest stored price per product and a Telegram Markdown alert for changes.

**Setup:** edit *Workflow Config* (chat ID, sheet ID), attach Google Sheets + Telegram credentials, create sheet `price_history` with the header row listed in akis-aciklama.md, then set *Settings > Error Workflow* to this workflow.

### Pagination loop
State (page, accumulated products) flows Pagination State -> Fetch -> Parse -> Has Next Page? -> Advance Page -> Polite Delay -> back to Pagination State. Exit when the page has no `rel="next"` link or the `maxPages` safety bound is hit.

### Controlled failure branch
Transport errors (after 3 retries), non-2xx status codes, zero products on a page or unparsable price cards all land here: alert is sent, then *Abort Execution* fails the run so nothing is persisted.

### Global safety net
Catches anything outside the controlled branch (Sheets/Telegram outages, code exceptions). Skips errors raised by *Abort Execution* to avoid duplicate alerts.
